rows.title: finance expense reports handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] finance expense reports records verified in status "approved" must be moved to status "submitted". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: finance expense reports handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For finance expense reports records verified in status "approved": if the record's employee_id is "10", move it to status "reimbursed"; otherwise move it to status "submitted". Apply exactly one transition.
